Glossary.TagSkill:
A few of your skills are Tag skills, marking them as your areas of expertise. Tag skills represent a focused training in those skills, a special affinity or talent with that discipline.

Tag skills increase your chances of a critical success. When you use a tagged skill, each d20 that rolls equal or under the skill rank is a critical success, scoring two successes instead of 1.

Wizard.SelectOrigin: Select an origin to see details.
Wizard.SelectOriginHint: Select an origin above. Full description, benefits, and penalties appear here.

Skills.Instructions: Choose your tag skills (★). Each tag skill starts at rank 2. Tag skills result in a critical success if you roll under the skill value. Spend skill points (9 + INT) to raise skills; max rank {max} at creation.
Skills.ResetFromSpecial: S.P.E.C.I.A.L. changed — skill tags and ranks were reset.

Perks.Instructions: Click a perk to read it. Use the checkbox to select starting perk(s). Requirements you do not meet block selection only.
Perks.SelectHint: Select a perk from the list to view its description.

DisabledRobotOnly.Hint: Mister Handy requires a robot actor sheet. Create or open a robot actor to select this origin.

DisabledHumanOnRobot.Hint: This origin is not available on robot actor sheets. Use a human character sheet, or choose Mister Handy.

Equipment.Instructions: Choose a starting equipment pack for your origin. Resolve any choices, then continue. Tag skill gear is listed automatically.
Equipment.TrinketDesc: Roll on the Random Trinkets table (Core Rulebook p. 80), or enter a d20 result manually.
Equipment.CompendiumHint: Click underlined items to open them from the compendium. Hover for details.
Equipment.SelectPack: Select an equipment pack to see contents and choices.

Special.Instructions: All S.P.E.C.I.A.L. attributes start at 5. Spend 5 points to increase them (each +1 costs 1 point). You may reduce an attribute to 4 to regain 1 point. Min 4, max 10.
Special.NoSkillsForAttribute: No skills use this attribute as default.
Special.NoPerksUnlocked: None unlocked at this value yet.
Special.NoPerksLocked: No perks require a higher value.

Blurb.str: Physical prowess; melee damage; how much you can carry.
Blurb.per: Awareness and initiative; used for energy weapon attacks.
Blurb.end: Toughness and resilience; affects HP and Big Guns.
Blurb.int: Knowledge and problem-solving; affects skill points.
Blurb.agi: Nimbleness and precision; used for Small Guns.
Blurb.luc: Fortune and twists of fate; luck points and rerolls.
